approval.confirmation_reference: The user authorized uninterrupted best-in-plan execution without repeated routine approvals.
approval.scope: One immutable three-seed relation-only training on all C01-C06 fit sequences with C07 selection, using frozen V2 geometry checkpoints and the sealed endpoint-observability sidecar. Zero C08+, graph or M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D; three serial seeds, three full fit epochs per seed, C07 loss selection after every epoch and one final three-seed C07 evaluation.

failure_policy: Any source, population, frozen-state, gradient, optimizer-step, resource or isolation failure fails the run. A scientific C07 failure stops before C08/graph; do not add epochs, tune thresholds on C08, select seeds or add rules.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.geometry: C07 sampled-surface error and continuous geometry macro improve at least 10% over the corrected same-input non-learning baseline, with primitive F1 and target coverage not below baseline.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.isolation: C08 rows, C09/C10 worlds, graph replays and M-TARE reads remain exactly zero; no threshold, checkpoint or method choice uses them.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.objective: Only the mean of the registered port-relations and uncertainty-calibration families drives updates; sparse cardinality and all six families remain reported without adding a seventh loss.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.population: Every seed reads exactly 426552 fit rows and 64644 C07 rows per epoch for three epochs; seeds are 0/1/2 and total optimizer steps are 240624.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.relations: C07 observable attachment F1 improves at least 5 points over the corrected non-learning baseline and the learned safe score yields at least one true attachment at precision >=0.98.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: Wall time <=24 h, host RSS/GPU process/PyTorch allocation each <=16 GiB and result <=6 GiB.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.seeds: At least two of three independent seeds pass every geometry, primitive, coverage, relation and nonempty-safe gate in the same direction.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.transfer: Each seed transfers its own V2 selected geometry/temporal state exactly; only 742149 parameters in 64 relation/evidence tensors train and the frozen-state digest is unchanged.

purpose: Test whether correcting endpoint observability and learning deployment-time endpoint evidence converts the proven V2 geometry representation into reliable physical primitive connections without retraining the backbone.
retention: Keep all three selected/epoch checkpoints, histories, commands, resource monitors, complete C07 metrics, paper figures, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: 60 C01-C06 topology parents for fit and 10 disjoint C07 parents for selection; three geometry realizations are paired repeated measures within a parent.
sampling.rule: For each seed run exactly three deterministic full fit epochs. Evaluate all C07 rows after each epoch and select the minimum mean(port_relations, uncertainty_calibration). Final thresholds and science gates use C07 once after all checkpoints are frozen.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a C01-C07 causal LiDAR shards
sealed P1b construction primitive/relation Teacher shards
three V2 selected checkpoints used only for geometry/temporal transfer
sealed corrected same-input non-learning C07 baseline

split.development_transfer: C08 is not opened by this run even if C07 passes; the decision only authorizes a separately sealed C08 endpoint-observability sidecar and zero-adaptation transfer.
split.fit: All C01-C06 parents and three paired geometries provide gradients.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V2 C07 failures justify only the frozen observability correction. V2 relation weights and predictions are discarded; only geometry/temporal tensors transfer.
split.selection: All C07 parents select one checkpoint per seed and final thresholds; C07 never changes the data, support band, architecture, epoch count or gates.
split.strict_test: C09/C10 and M-TARE benchmark worlds remain unread.

teacher.labels: Swept primitive geometry, temporal visibility, attachment, disconnected overlap and endpoint observability.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The model predicts endpoint evidence at deployment. No graph runs here; only a later actual traversal can commit an edge.
teacher.source: P1b construction geometry/relations plus the sealed 0.25 m per-window endpoint-support validity sidecar.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Endpoint support bits are loss/evaluator targets only. Construction identity, world/TNG, absolute pose, true endpoints and future frames never enter forward.
teacher.valid_mask: A matched physical attachment trains/scores only when both endpoints are observed. Hidden physical connections are unknown, never negative; unmatched sparse queries remain valid negative regularization.
